                     Paired SHA-256: Test Vectors 

Abstract

   This text is a test fixture for vector's iterated vectors, laid out
   as an RFC's plain text so that vector reads it.  It is not an RFC.

1.  Pairing

   A pair starts from the texts a = "abc" and b = "xyz".  For each
   iteration, set a to sha256Pair(a, b) and b to the old a, both at
   once.  The final result is the a left after the last iteration.

   Pairs are run for 1 iteration, for 2 iterations and for 1,000
   iterations.
